title: Graduate civil engineer or civil draftsperson - expression of interest (Melbourne)
content_text:
Careers at Taylors Development Strategists
Relationships, Expertise and Solutions across Urban Development, Built Environments, Infrastructure and Engineering and Project Management.

title: Graduates / Undergraduates - expression of interest
location: Brisbane, Ipswich, Gold Coast, Warwick, Mount Isa QLD (multiple offices)
content_text:
Graduates / Undergraduates
If you are studying towards a Bachelor of Engineering qualification or have recently graduated and looking for hands on practical approach and interesting / exciting projects then reach out to us. Osborn Consulting have multiple offices, Brisbane, Mount Isa, Warwick, Ipswich, Gold Coast and remote other locations. We may be just the company you wish to start your engineering career with. Get in Touch with us today.

With over four decades of experience, Osborn Consulting Engineers has been a trusted provider of engineering services throughout all stages of a project from concept design to construction. Based in the Southeast, we pride ourselves on our commitment to excellence and innovation in every project we undertake.

How to apply:
Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience to admin@osbornconsulting.com.au or via the submission box on the careers page.

Also listed: Civil Designer / Drafter 3-6 month contract/casual based in Ipswich (starting May 2025 note on page may be stale); Principal and Lead roles separately advertised.
apply_instructions: Email resume and cover letter to admin@osbornconsulting.com.au (careers page states this inbox accepts applications) or use the careers page submission form.

title: Graduate Engineer - Roads & Highways
content_text:
Graduate Engineer - Roads & Highways
Location Sunshine Coast, QLD. Work Type Full time. Positions 1.
Join Calibre Transport team Sunshine Coast office.
The Calibre Graduate Program is a two-year integrated experience combining on-the-job learning, professional and technical training, mentoring and development opportunities.
Calibre is part of Calibre Group alongside Diona and Sevengen. Engineering, consulting, construction, project delivery across Australia and New Zealand.
Requirements: recently graduated with relevant tertiary qualifications in Civil Engineering and 0-1 years of experience. Keen interest in Calibre, excellent communication, commitment, willingness to learn, desire to work in a dynamic deadline-driven environment.
Apply with resume, covering letter and academic transcripts. Applications without those will not be considered.
Job no: YMY8M. Verified open 3 Oct 2026 via LiveHire.
apply_instructions: Apply on LiveHire with resume, covering letter and academic transcripts.
